Marimo Spatial Grid Cell
Add this code into your next notebook cell to ingest and display the matrix states interactively:
import marimo as mo
import numpy as np

# Load or generate dimensional node matrix based on your spatial configuration
def get_node_matrix():
    # Placeholder or dynamic load from your spatial engine config
    return np.random.randint(1, 10, size=(3, 3))

matrix_data = get_node_matrix()

# Render interactive table or grid representation in Marimo
spatial_grid = mo.ui.table(matrix_data.tolist())
spatial_grid
